title: feat(gen): publish an RFC 9727 API catalog under /.well-known
author: patbing

gist.summary: Added GET /.well-known/api-catalog to gen.pollinations.ai so agents can discover the API without guessing /openapi.json. The RFC 9727 linkset points to /openapi.json as the service description and /docs/llm.txt as the service documentation. Links use the serving host’s public origin, and the response includes the linkset content type and profile, CORS headers, and a one-hour public cache header. llms.txt now links to the catalog.
